info.title: Undying Dominion
info.description: The WebSocket protocol of an Undying Dominion server. Every message is one JSON object. A client sends commands, each naming a `command`; the server sends `welcome`, `state` every tick (10 Hz), `story` in a campaign, and `error`. Join first (or rejoin), then play. The server is authoritative: commands are requests, and the next state shows what happened. Served by every server at `/asyncapi.json`.

join.name: join
join.summary: Take a place in the world. Accepted only on a socket that hasn't joined.

commander.description: The commander to field, an id from welcome.roster, e.g. BULWARK. Without it the free-for-all gives you a random one and says which. A campaign ignores it: you are the Necromancer. An unknown id answers `No commander called {id}`, and NECROMANCER answers `The Necromancer walks only in the campaign`; the socket stays open to try again.

rejoin.name: rejoin
rejoin.summary: Take back your place after a dropped connection, with the token from your last welcome. Accepted only on a socket that hasn't joined.

summon.name: summon
summon.summary: Summon or call a unit of your commander's retinue beside your commander, paying its summonCost in energy.

unit.description: A type in your commander's retinue (welcome.commander.retinue), e.g. SHIELDBEARER for the Bulwark or SKELETON_WARRIOR for the Necromancer. Another type answers `{label} doesn't answer to {name}.`, and a SEALED commander hears `You are sealed and cannot {verb}.`

move.name: move
move.summary: March units to a tile. With attackMove they fight whatever they meet on the way.

units.description: Ids of your own units, at most 200.
Ids of your own units, at most 200.
Ids of your own units, at most 200.

raise.name: raise
raise.summary: Raise a corpse within raiseRange of your necromancer into your legion, paying its raiseCost.

explode.name: explode
explode.summary: Corpse Explosion: blast a corpse within raiseRange, damaging everything within explodeRadius.

fuse.name: fuse
fuse.summary: Fuse fuseCount Skeleton Warriors standing within fuseRadius into a Skeleton King.

units.description: Ids of your own units, at most 200.

mend.name: mend
mend.summary: Mend units: rooted for mendTicks, then fully healed.

units.description: Ids of your own units, at most 200.

trap.name: trap
trap.summary: Grave Wardens lay a hidden trap where they stand, rooted for trapSetTicks.

units.description: Ids of your own units, at most 200.

resume.name: resume
resume.summary: Set the world running again, however it was paused by hand.

reading.name: reading
reading.summary: A story card opened or closed. A lone reader pauses the world.

save.name: save
save.summary: Save a solo campaign. The reply comes back as a notice in you.notices.

force.description: Replace a save with this name.

welcome.name: welcome
welcome.summary: After a successful join or rejoin, and on every chapter change: everything about the world that doesn't change, and your token.

token.description: Your bearer secret for rejoin. The same for as long as you hold your place.

map.description: Tiles, with [0,0] at the top left. Everything not covered by an obstacle is GROUND.

maxCorpses.description: The most corpses a world keeps. Past it the oldest crumble.

look.description: How the client draws it, e.g. BEAST or UNDEAD.

additionalProperties.description: summonCost and raiseCost are -1 where the unit can't be summoned or raised.

commander.description: Your commander's kit; the Necromancer's in a campaign.

roster.description: Every commander you may pick or join as, by role. Empty in a campaign.

state.name: state
state.summary: Every tick, your view of the world: only what your units can see. A client that falls behind skips stale states.

legion.description: Summoned legion members, counted against legionCap.

necromancerId.description: Your commander's unit (the name is kept from when everyone was a necromancer); null while fallen.

respawnIn.description: Ticks until your commander rises again; 0 while standing.

notices.description: Messages for you since the last state, including replies to save.

raised.description: Legion members raised from corpses. They take no room under legionCap.

next.description: The commander you'll rise as after a `pick`, or null.

energy.description: What your energy (soul) is called: Soul, Mana, Valor...

cooldowns.description: Seconds until each of your abilities is ready, by ability id; 0 when ready. All 0 after a rise.

owner.description: A player id, or 0 for wild creatures.

raised.description: Present and true for a unit raised from a corpse.

modeEndsIn.description: Present while rooted mending or laying a trap: ticks left.

expiresIn.description: Present on a unit raised from a corpse: ticks until it returns to the dead. A raised unit lasts 120 s plus 30 s per level of the necromancer who raised it.

statuses.description: Statuses on the unit. On your own units, all of them; on others', only might, ward, haste, slow, rooted, silenced, sealed, taunted, unstoppable, burning and evading.

shield.description: Damage the unit's shield will still absorb; 0 without one.

units.description: A STEALTHED unit of another player is left out unless one of your units stands next to it, your commander sees through stealth within its range, or your reveal covers it.

decaysIn.description: Ticks until it crumbles, or null: corpses stay until used. A world keeps its newest 400, and past that the oldest crumble.

items.description: ATTACK: a hits b, from x,y to x2,y2. DEATH, SUMMON, RAISE, FUSE, MEND, TRAP_SET, TRAP_SPRUNG: unit a at x,y. LEVEL_UP: player a reached level b. EXPLOSION: player a, radius b, at x,y. CAST: unit a cast `ability` from x,y at unit b (0 for a tile or itself) on tile x2,y2, over `radius`.

events.description: What happened this tick, where you could see it. Empty while paused.

away.description: Their connection dropped and their place is held for them.

fog.description: Base64 bitmask of visible tiles, one bit per tile, row by row, lowest bit first.

stragglers.description: In a chapter won by clearing every creature, the tiles [x, y] of the last few (5 or fewer) once no timed wave is still to come, regardless of fog. Empty otherwise.

by.description: Who paused it, for player and host pauses.

paused.description: Present while the world is stopped.

story.name: story
story.summary: In a campaign: a chapter's briefing, a line said mid-chapter, victory, defeat or the finale.

error.name: error
error.summary: A message that couldn't be acted on. The socket stays open unless the server closes it.

examples: Too many of you in this world
No more space in this world
That session has ended. Join again
Names are 1 to 16 letters, digits, spaces, _ or -

payload.message: No more space in this world

dismiss.name: dismiss
dismiss.summary: Let units go from your legion: they crumble to nothing, freeing their slots. No corpse, no soul back, no kill for anyone. Works on rooted units; your necromancer is never dismissed. The reply is a notice: "Dismissed N from your legion."

units.description: Ids of your own units, at most 200.

pick.name: pick
pick.summary: Choose the commander you'll rise as after your next fall. While fielded you hear `You will rise as {name}, {title}.`; while fallen, `You rise as {name}, {title}.` In a campaign it answers `The campaign is played as the Necromancer`.

cast.name: cast
cast.summary: Use one of your commander's three abilities, cast by your commander's unit. A cast that fails a check spends nothing and starts no cooldown, and a notice says why: on cooldown, energy, silenced, fallen, range, sight, or the wrong target. CORPSE and SELECTION abilities (the Necromancer's) keep their own commands: raise, explode, fuse.

ability.description: An ability id from your kit, e.g. shield-bash. One not in your kit answers `Could not parse arguments`.

target.description: A unit id, for an ability whose target is ENEMY, ENEMY_COMMANDER or ALLY.

x.description: With y, the tile for a TILE ability.

kit.description: A commander as commanders/roster.json writes it: who they are, their unit, the retinue they summon or call, three abilities on R, F and X, and a passive. Times are in seconds.

energy.description: What the energy pool (you.soul) is called for this commander.

verb.description: Summon or Call, as the HUD names summoning.

unit.description: The commander's own unit. A string names a type in welcome.unitTypes.

retinue.description: What `summon` accepts. A string names a type in welcome.unitTypes.

units.description: Types only an ability places, such as a decoy. Not summonable.

kitUnit.description: A unit type: its full stats, or an archetype (GRUNT, SHOT, ADEPT, SCOUT, GUARD) with the stats it changes. welcome.unitTypes has every type's final numbers.

slot.description: BASIC on R, UTILITY on F, SIGNATURE on X.

range.description: Tiles from the commander; 0 when absent.

radius.description: Tiles around the target tile, or around the commander for AROUND_SELF.

affects.description: Who the effects land on, unless an effect names its own. TARGET when absent.

effect.description: One thing an ability does, in order. A dash resolves first, so later areas centre on the landing.

stealthBonus.description: Percent more when cast from stealth.

afterSeconds.description: A status that lands this long after the cast.

magnitude.description: Percent, or hp per second for REGEN and BURNING.
Percent; for energyRegen, tenths of energy per second.
